mechanism: Diltiazem may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of betamethasone, potentially increasing corticosteroid levels; betamethasone may enhance hypokalemia risk and counteract diltiazem's antihypertensive effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure, electrolytes (particularly potassium), and corticosteroid efficacy; consider dose adjustment of betamethasone if signs of excess corticosteroid effect appear.
